_comment: Known kernels for the Arch family. Discovery is generic (any package with a -headers sibling); this file adds descriptions, a provider tab, the repository a kernel normally comes from, and hardware requirements. Add your own in ~/.config/griffin-kernel-manager/kernels.json (same format).

kernels.name: linux
kernels.description: The mainline kernel, stable branch (Arch's default).

kernels.name: linux-zen
kernels.description: Zen kernel: desktop and low-latency tuning.

kernels.name: linux-rt-lts
kernels.description: PREEMPT_RT real-time kernel on a long-term-support base.

kernels.name: linux-xanmod
kernels.description: XanMod: desktop- and gaming-tuned kernel (main branch).

kernels.name: linux-cachyos
kernels.description: CachyOS kernel: BORE/EEVDF scheduler plus performance patches.

kernels.name: linux-clear
kernels.description: Kernel with Clear Linux's patch set.

kernels.name: linux-tkg-pds
kernels.description: linux-tkg: customisable kernel built with the PDS scheduler.

kernels.name: linux-lts-tkg-bmq
kernels.description: linux-tkg on an LTS base, built with the BMQ scheduler.

kernels.name: linux-ck
kernels.description: Con Kolivas' patchset (hrtimer, BFQ and scheduler work). Comes from the separate repo-ck repository.

kernels.name: linux-amd
kernels.description: Kernel built for AMD Zen 4 (znver4) CPUs.

kernels.name: linux-nitrous
kernels.description: Clang-built kernel optimised for Skylake and newer.
